test_evidence.reporting_detail: One real handler persistence/continuation parent,13 altered-output negatives and2semantic helper tests. Positive handler path submits pruned facts. Root ran combined suite; verifier read completed log.

checks.runtime: Explicit runtimeRoot loads pinned handler in isolated subprocess. Supplied pinned CLI seeds ledger/outcomes/events. Candidate-command binding checks before/after execution.
checks.oracle_exposure: Public case exposes observations/paths but not expected facts, full expected output, membership patterns or injected dependency objects. Allowlisted command arguments prevent oracle-file reads through fixture ports. Native model audit remains required.
checks.facts: Known optional empty fields canonicalise; unknown/command-owned data remains visible and rejected. Exact generated summary is still checked.
checks.economics: Equivalent numeric spellings accepted while total tokens, provenance, shipped denominator, known total/per-shipped cost presence and numeric values remain checked. Positive-currency and transcript-source cases are present.
checks.membership: Independent per-ID assertions verify plain/skipped/flagged/human-AC precedence and superseded separation; review cases separate ordinary/resumable PRs and build/prep holds. PREP-1 absent from outcomes and admitted list.
checks.fixture: PR201/202 controlled forge state OPEN matches pr-open outcomes.
checks.effects: Handler stdout equals actual summary.md and seeded reference; authoritative run-state hashes unchanged.
checks.publication: Exactly2channel normalisations and publications, correct result/channel/target/order, full canonical summary retained and tracker economics checked semantically.
checks.continuation: No-budget ready queue requires one controlled continuation with complete issue set, no facts/summary files and no final publication.
checks.fault: Unreadable ledger exit2 surfaced; no successful publication or continuation.
checks.negative_tests: Authority mutation, invented facts, dropped follow-up, rewritten summary, duplicate invocation, wrong target, lost economics/banner, missing normalisation, capacity deferral, omitted ready issue, post-fault publication and missing command result rejected.

resolved_findings: Merged forge response for open PRs
scope: Actual pinned cmdRunSummary handler and production ledger writers with real file persistence. Forge/health/metering/budget are fixed injected responses; rendering/publication/continuation are controlled stubs.
limits: No model baseline or candidate result follows from this deterministic preflight.
No real dependency acquisition, hosted tracker write, run-close/andon, actual build, full dispatcher model invocation, full autonomous workflow or rendering-quality proof.
Post-command identity normalisation does not prove pre-write normalisation inside the handler; task explicitly disclaims it.
Claimed-by-peer remains unchanged and outside boundary.
Missing/malformed facts warning paths are covered by repository tests, not this model fixture.
